description: Task-shaped terminal scenarios for pattern-native paths. Soft expected paths are observational, not hard locks. Do not force freehand bans to inflate rates.

scenarios.title: Replace middle section; keep intro
scenarios.prompt: On this focused page, replace the middle top-level section with a staff directory (or the closest active-theme section pattern). Keep the page introduction/header and any final section intact. Prefer prepare-pattern-change (mode=replace) with the correct target_path, then propose-pattern-replace. Do not invent facts. Do not rewrite unrelated sections freehand unless no section pattern fits.

scenarios.title: Replace FAQ section by role
scenarios.prompt: On this focused page, replace only the FAQ section with a cleaner FAQ/accordion pattern from the active theme. Keep the header and non-FAQ body sections. Prefer prepare-pattern-change → propose-pattern-replace targeted at the FAQ section (use read-block-tree top_level_sections roles/headings to pick the path). Map existing FAQ copy into slots when possible. Do not redesign the whole page freehand unless no FAQ pattern exists.

scenarios.title: Replace header band only
scenarios.prompt: Replace only the header/title band (usually top-level path 0) with a better active-theme header or page-introduction pattern. Do not rewrite body copy or later sections. Prefer prepare-pattern-change mode=replace on the header path, then propose-pattern-replace.

scenarios.title: Add CTA section without replacing
scenarios.prompt: Add a contact/apply call-to-action section after the main content. Do not replace existing sections. Prefer prepare-pattern-change with mode=insert (or propose-pattern-insert) using an active-theme CTA pattern. Replace required authoring placeholders with credible copy before staging.

scenarios.title: Copy-only fix; no redesign
scenarios.prompt: Make a minimal copy edit only: fix wording or a small typo in one paragraph on this page. Do not redesign layout. Do not call prepare-pattern-change or freehand rewrite the whole document. Prefer surgical tools (batch/attrs/content update of a single block).

scenarios.title: Restyle section; keep links and numbers
scenarios.prompt: Restyle the main body or FAQ section with a fitting theme pattern, but preserve every existing URL and phone/numeric token from that section (use prepare carry_forward / map into slots). Prefer prepare-pattern-change → propose-pattern-replace. Do not invent new URLs.

scenarios.title: Verify a sound page needs no change
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate whether this focused page already has a coherent hierarchy, readable copy, and a clear next step. If it does, make no proposal and report no change. Do not redesign merely to create activity; stage only a narrowly justified correction.

scenarios.title: Legacy one-shot Improve brief (adoption thermometer)
scenarios.notes: Legacy one-shot. Prefer queue-improve-one.php (eval→act) for production-shaped Improve measurement. Not a capability fail if freehand wins.

scenarios.title: Improve evaluate→act (production-shaped)
scenarios.notes: Production-shaped Improve. run-scenario.php S9b runs evaluate→act (same as queue-improve-one.php default).
